title: Truth Oracle Access
description: A bounded evidence-review workflow within Truth Oracle. Review one public URL or bounded artifact against up to five acceptance criteria, preserve source-linked findings and uncertainty, and produce a timestamped assessment. The public guide and claim-record template remain free. Paid access is held until checkout-to-delivery is independently verified.
required_input: One public URL or bounded artifact and up to five acceptance criteria. Checkout is not enabled until entitlement and delivery proof pass.
availability_note: No separate delivery-proof audit is sold. Its bounded review capability is absorbed into Truth Oracle. Paid checkout remains held until payment, entitlement, and delivery reconcile end to end.

title: Supplier Quote Comparison
description: One-time service for buyers with 2-5 supplier quotes. Normalizes price, scope, missing costs, MOQ, lead time and payment terms into a source-backed decision packet. Missing information remains marked unknown.
required_input: 2-5 PDF, CSV, JSON or Markdown supplier quotes plus purchase requirements or scope
availability_note: Paid checkout is held. Use the free browser-side worksheet; do not initiate a purchase until intake, persistence, and fulfillment are independently verified.
